papers.title_en: Uncertainty Is Not Enough: Value-of-Information Routing for Mixtures of LoRA Experts
papers.authors: Tom Saliencro, Rohan Desai, Priya Nair, Maya Lindqvist, Daniel Whitmore
papers.evidence: 面向MoE专家选择的信息价值路由
papers.tldr: 现有动态路由依据不确定性激活更多专家，但不确定性不等于有用计算，无法区分可恢复风险与残余风险。为此提出VI-MoLE，将路由形式化为信息价值分配，在标定数据上学习反事实风险并生成同时上风险证书，按全局预算分配边际风险收益，终端证书决定回答或弃权。理论证明证书有效性、贪心分配最优性和分配遗憾界，实验表明匹配计算准确率、覆盖率及分布偏移下均优于固定和动态路由器。该工作为MoE-LoRA提供可靠的路由决策机制，兼具理论保证与实用性能。
papers.abstract_en: Mixtures of low-rank adaptation experts increase parameter-efficient capacity by routing each input through a subset of adapters. Recent dynamic routers activate more experts when the router or prediction is uncertain. This rule silently equates uncertainty with useful additional computation: an uncertain example may contain complementary, unqueried expert evidence, but it may instead remain ambiguous after every expert agrees. We formulate routing as certified value-of-information allocation. VI-MoLE learns the counterfactual risk remaining after each expert prefix, converts these predictions into simultaneous upper-risk certificates on held-out calibration data, and spends a global adapter budget on the token--layer action with the largest certified marginal risk reduction per unit cost. A terminal certificate then decides whether to answer or abstain. Unlike an uncertainty gate, this procedure distinguishes present ambiguity from recoverable and residual risk. We prove simultaneous certificate validity, optimal greedy allocation under diminishing certified gains, and allocation regret under value-estimation error. The evaluation protocol tests matched-compute accuracy, certificate coverage, risk--coverage, distribution shift, and tail latency against fixed and dynamic MoE-LoRA routers.

papers.evidence: 面向混合Mamba-2-Transformer混合专家模型的训练方案
papers.tldr: 归一化Transformer（nGPT）将所有参数和激活向量约束在单位超球面上，以促进表示学习与训练稳定。目前尚缺乏系统的训练方案，阻碍其实际应用。为此，本文提出了一套实用的nGPT训练配方，包括Logit梯度预处理、对数学习率衰减、GatedAdamW、角度更新控制以及可选的探索机制，并应用于混合Mamba-2-Transformer MoE模型。在14B总参数规模下，该配方使nGPT在达到相同验证损失时仅需约一半的训练token，显著减少计算成本，且方法可扩展到所考察的最大模型。
papers.abstract_en: The normalized Transformer (nGPT) realizes hyperspherical representation learning by constraining model parameter vectors and activation vectors to the unit hypersphere. In this paper, we describe a practical training recipe for nGPT and evaluate it on modern hybrid Mamba-2--Transformer Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models. The recipe introduces Logit Gradient Preconditioning, Logarithmic Learning Rate Decay, GatedAdamW, angular update control, and optional exploration mechanisms. Compared with an unnormalized model of the same hybrid MoE architecture trained with AdamW, the 14B-total-parameter nGPT model reaches the same validation loss using approximately half as many training tokens. The recipe scales across the models considered, which contain up to 14B total parameters.
